scope: Own static didactic onion-epidermis investigation; no simulation or practical microscopy certificate. M6.02/M6.03 contracts unchanged.

catalogRefinement.C02: Interpret this case, never guarantee immediate complete recovery.

catalogRefinement.C04-C17: Explicit additional planning, evidence-type and mechanism criteria authorized by this development request.

observations.kind: newly authored didactic data, not laboratory measurements or calculated dynamics
observations.cell: Initially intact onion epidermis, without chloroplasts; later integrity is not measured.
observations.waterLoss: Given total water potentials including pressure: vacuole > cytosol > exterior; water permeates cell membrane and tonoplast; sucrose largely retained.
observations.return: Water replacement may favor uptake if exchange is sufficient, total potentials favor it, and membranes retain appropriate function. No measured final potentials or guaranteed recovery.
observations.wall: Comparatively stable in all supplied records; initial positive turgor qualitative, not calculated.
observations.schedule: Three paired preparations from one onion: initial run and two technical repetitions. Follow the same ten marked cells per field at baseline, 6 minutes after sucrose (control water), and 6 minutes after return to water. Times are chosen observation intervals, not universal reaction times. No population-level biological independence claimed.
observations.measurement: Mean protoplast volume estimated from hypothetical image stacks, relative to that field at baseline = 100%. Didactic uncertainty ±4 percentage points per estimate. Detachment is the count of ten marked cells with visible separation. Vakuole is qualitatively smaller after treatment. These are supplied observations, not newly simulated measurements.

recovery.finding: Clear increase after return, still below baseline. Compatible with renewed uptake and partial recovery, not full immediate recovery or proof of every cell function.

limited.finding: Return differences remain within stated uncertainty; no clear recovery at this observation point. Residual sucrose, limited observation duration, or damage are possible, unproven alternatives; no death diagnosis.

answerShape: Exact object with one dense array of stable option IDs per field. Single fields at most one; multi fields at most all defined options; duplicate IDs, unknown/extra fields, sparse arrays/accessors/prototypes rejected technically, never assessed as biological error.
uncertainOption: unsure is allowed in every field, produces clarify; never a biological contradiction.
aggregation: incorrect if any proved contradiction; otherwise clarify if any unsure; otherwise empty if all arrays empty; otherwise correct only if every criterion complete; otherwise partial. Correct selected parts stay visible, no total numerical grade.
hypothesisPolicy: Judge bounded testability and justified conditions, not whether a later finding supports the prediction. The return prediction remains a valid hypothesis in the limited-recovery case. Own hypothesis text is outside this answer and not evaluated.
limitsPolicy: not_unique plus at least one of exchange/time/damage; any additional correct alternatives accepted. Each is conditional, no cause inferred from failure alone.
evidence: Pure deterministic checker returns versioned context binding and selected option IDs with reasons. Session receipt only for current actual result identity, revision, context and verified assistance history after data reveal; changes invalidate; no extension of eight persisted metadata.
freeText: Own prediction and complete written plan are outside the assessed answer; volatile DOM/controller memory only, never serialized into result, storage or telemetry.
